finding_1_correct_ranking_unconditional_.summary: Excised unconditional pH rejection (pH > 9.0 and pH < 4.2) from ranking.py. Ordinary Liebig non-compensatory suitability scoring and ranking proceeds across all canonical crops without universal bypass.

finding_2_preserve_legitimate_no_recomme.summary: Preserved legitimate NO_RECOMMENDATION_SUITABLE status whenever the top candidate crop fails to reach the minimum agronomic viability threshold (suitability_score < 40.0). High-fidelity land reclamation advisories (Gypsum for sodicity, Limestone for acidity, drought advisory for hyper-arid) generated.

finding_3_multi_ph_boundary_evaluation.summary: Evaluated across boundary pH values (4.0, 4.2, 8.6, 9.0, 9.2). Proved that pH alone never causes automatic rejection when candidate crops achieve viable suitability scores (>= 40.0).

finding_4_severe_soil_warnings_and_soft_.summary: Verified that severe soil warnings remain visible (Soil Acidity Warning at pH <= 4.5, Alkalinity/Sodicity Warning at pH >= 8.5) and Tier 2 Liebig soft penalties remain active (ph_score = 30.0 or 60.0), directly limiting the Liebig minimum factor for out-of-range crops.

finding_5_deterministic_reproducibility.summary: Verified that 50 consecutive runs across diverse pH queries produce 100% bitwise identical output hashes. Zero random variation or ranking instability.
